name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Gardener goes with Pierce or Chef goes with Spanner.
Exactly one of these is true: Blackwood goes with Revenge; Pistol goes with Gardener; Envy goes with Chef.
Spite does not go with Chef.
Between Chef and Heir, one goes with Grimsby and the other with Crowbar.
Grimsby goes with either Revenge or Governess (but not both).
Spanner goes with at least one of Envy or Chef.
Blackwood goes with exactly two of Crowbar, Revenge, and Chef.
